author: perrotta
body:
#### PR description:

There were still a few GTs which did not rely on the automatically updated ones in `Configuration/AlCa7python/autoCond.py`

This was at the origin of the error in the RelVals-INPUT tests, as reported in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52289#issuecomment-6685439126, when a new record was added in the updated ones, but of course the hardcoded GTs didn't have it.

This PR replaces the automatically assigned GTs in UPC2025 and UPC2026 workflows (which were surfaced by those failing tests) as well as a few `data_express` ones, which were probably not run in the bot tests.

#### PR validation:

Rely on the bot tests

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

It will be backported if needed in CMSSW_17_1_X and CMSSW_17_0_X, even though RelVals-INPUT tests do not seem to fail in those releas cycles (to be verified)
title: Do not use hardcoded GTs in relval steps
